high_level_description: This image shows a close-up of a wine label. The label is predominantly white with gold and black accents. The text on the label reads "ROCHE MAZEN" in large, bold, gold letters at the top. Below the name, there is an illustration of a landscape featuring a castle or fortress surrounded by trees and hills, suggesting a historical or rural setting. The main text on the label states "PINOT NOIR," indicating that the wine is a Pinot Noir variety. Further down, it specifies "PAYS D'OC," which refers to the Pays d'Oc region in France, known for its wines.
